findings: Original2023–24 PDF13/printed11 explicitly attributes Aji Thu Ekathi to Xavier High School Khandagiri students. PDF14/printed12 explicitly attributes Nagabali Ra Abhiman to Pitamahal Ashram School students.
Candidate use of these two named films as student making is supported with organizer attribution; no language, learning outcome, payment, production-support or individual-role claim is established.

PDF17/printed15 is a reproduced media collage. Its Dhwani clipping concerns festival inauguration/participation, not named completed BPFTIO assistance. Small clippings were not comprehensively transcribed.
2024–25 PDF10 uses screenings in a SHRUTI therapy/education context. PDF27 records a projector asset purchase, without a named film, beneficiary or Dhwani link.
Failure to establish delivered support in these records is not evidence of non-delivery or nonpayment.

Final synthesis properly treats the2016 report as contemporaneous secondary reporting, and the later organizer report as a separate account; retrospective or repeat screening remains possible rather than established.
candidate_verdict: Final candidate separates the reported2016 screening from the later annual-report mention. Supported for later source-attributed editorial integration, not installed or published in this research cycle.
limits: Only five original page images independently inspected in this pass; broader report coverage belongs to named coordinator/researcher inspections.
No film playback, financial audit, outcome verification or public implementation performed.
The original-report delivery gap remains open. Full56-page coverage is the combined coordinator/researcher account, not this reviewer’s five-page visual scope.
reviewed_candidate_text: Children can enter cinema as makers as well as viewers. In 2016, Kallola-Junior included Aji Thu Ekathi, made by students of St Xavier's High School, Khandagiri. Aaina's later annual report also names Nagabali Ra Abhiman, made by students of Pitamahal Ashram School. These are concrete examples of children making room for their own stories.

independent_web_read.method: Direct original publisher page opened; article text lines55–97 read.
independent_web_read.finding: Contemporaneous report explicitly links Aji Thu Ekathi to St Xavier’s High School, Khandagiri, among student films screened. This establishes an earlier screening, not a 2024 production or premiere.
independent_web_read.limits: No actual film playback or original credit inspection. No independent audience-outcome or production-support verification.
